name: Netanel Ben Simon
biography: Netanel Ben-Simon has been a security researcher for over eight years, and is currently working with the Microsoft Offensive Research & Security Engineering (MORSE) team. He specializes in low-level vulnerability research, fuzzing & Exploitation on various platform types such as Windows, Linux, and Embedded Devices. Over the past year, he has conducted in-depth vulnerability research on different UEFI components with a focus on Windows security posture around the boot environment, bug hunting and mitigations.
